name: Toprope
notes: Not a climbing gym: 'Top Rope' is the adventure park of Kayaks Kfar Blum (rope bridges, archery, 90 m zip-line to the Jordan, 12 m climbing wall). Park open Fri/Sat, holidays, July-August; other days only zip-line/wall tickets, and the product pages carry a notice that the park/wall is still closed to visitors. No gym hours or day pass recorded (wall-only ticket 36 NIS is an attraction ticket). toprope.co.il and top-rope.co.il are unrelated rope-access companies. Official address: Kibbutz Kfar Blum, Upper Galilee (no street); our pin in Kfar Blum is plausible.
official_address: קיבוץ כפר בלום, גליל עליון (Kibbutz Kfar Blum, Upper Galilee)
